_comment: UAE -> Switzerland email matchers. Built from a REAL confirmation email read out of mufaddal@travnook.com on 2026-09-24, minutes after the live registration that produced reference SWDB82370725773.
_comment_discriminator: SWITZERLAND BREAKS THE PATTERN THE OTHER THREE COUNTRIES SHARE. Greece, Italy and Netherlands are each narrowed by the portal URL in the body ('/are/en/grc/' and so on), which the AE-ITA config calls 'the only part of the message that names the country unambiguously'. That is not true here: the Swiss confirmation contains NO URL AT ALL. Its prose names the country instead — 'for a visa appointment from UAE to Switzerland' — so that phrase is the discriminator. Verified against the real message; re-check it if VFS rewords the mail.
_comment_why_it_mattered: Without this file the Swiss confirmation fell through every route's narrowed matcher (each demanding a URL the message does not contain) and was caught by the inherited 'vfs_other' catch-all — reported as unrecognised GREEK mail, with the reference left unextracted. Confirmed by classifying the real email on 2026-09-24.

matchers.name: waitlist_confirmation
matchers._comment: Overrides ONLY body_contains. subject_contains ('Successfully Added to Waitlist') and the extract patterns survive from _default, and both were verified against the real message: 'Dear MUFADDAL CALCUTTAWALA ,' yields the name even with the space before the comma, and 'Your Unique Reference Number is SWDB82370725773 .' yields the reference. SWDB is a FOUR-letter prefix where Greece and Italy use three; the base pattern [A-Z0-9-]+ already covers it.

matchers.name: waitlist_invitation
matchers._comment_validity: *** NOT YET KNOWN — DELIBERATELY NOT GUESSED. *** Greece and Netherlands say 36 hours, Italy says 48, and the AE-NLD config warns that the base's 48 'is now the odd one out, and every new route should be checked rather than assumed'. No Swiss INVITATION has been seen yet, so the window is unverified. null here rather than a number so a wrong deadline cannot be computed and shown as fact. Set it from the real email when the first invitation arrives.
matchers._comment_body: PROVISIONAL. The confirmation's wording is confirmed; this line assumes the invitation names the country the same way. It is the reasonable inference — same sender, same template family — but it is an inference. Verify against the first real Swiss invitation, and if that mail does carry a portal URL, prefer '/are/en/che/' to match the other three configs.

Your Unique Reference Number is SWDB82370725773 . Your waitlist registration is active and is the only way to obtain an appointment for the General Appointment category.
